svg.title: System information panel for Osama Anwar
svg.desc: A fastfetch-style panel beside a camera aperture drawn in block characters. Host Windows 11, WSL2 and Linux. Shell PowerShell and bash. Current role Database Administrator at The Bank of Punjab. Previous role Camera and Image Evaluation Engineer. 32 public repositories containing 500 tracked files. Languages Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Inno Setup.
